comparison.objective: Change a dressing while maintaining clean-hand/dirty-hand separation; candidate breaks and recovers HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Contamination-aware dressing manipulation versus coaxial tooling, bimanual impact regulation, and loose-metal-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Complete the dressing without violating clean/dirty roles versus four fractures with no retained/lost tang, insert displacement, or damage.
comparison.reason: The central constraint is aseptic role separation, not controlled fracture of a retained mechanical feature. No spec versions or detailed contamination/scoring thresholds are available.
